propositions: Mode class inherits from str, causing functools.total_ordering to use inherited lexical comparison instead of intended rank ordering, leading to incorrect comparison results like bootstrap-throttle > reconcile-check evaluating false.
The five-mode MODE_CAPS mapping (reconcile-check=0, dry-run=0, bootstrap-strict=10, bootstrap-throttle=100, live=None) must be directly asserted and preserved across all changes.
Phase-gate round-trip through real ref backend must allow equal gated_mode targets and block higher targets.
Rich comparison operators in Mode class must follow the rank order: reconcile-check < dry-run < bootstrap-strict < bootstrap-throttle < live.
All persisted values, CLI vocabulary, library exports, MCP payloads, and workflow inputs must remain unchanged to maintain backward compatibility.
